# Non-sensitive local integration image

`non-sensitive-pattern-256x192.png` is a deterministic synthetic RGB gradient/checker pattern,
created locally with pngjs. It contains no photograph, person, text, EXIF, user content, or credential.
Dimensions: 256×192, single-frame PNG, 1,097 bytes.

This is a candidate transport/integration fixture, not a photograph or a performance benchmark.
No CuRe/TruFor decision or score is expected in advance. AI model loading, decoding and contract
compatibility can be checked; accuracy cannot be inferred from this pattern.

The existing 1×1 images in API tests do not satisfy the real AI server's minimum 32px dimensions.
Do not send this or any other fixture to an external service without explicit approval.
